reviews.title: Works Great and Easy to use
reviews.comment: This is my second one purchased. Works well easy to use and install. The pricing was fair and shipping was fast.
reviews.author: Kenny

reviews.title: Works as expected
reviews.comment: Works as expected for EVGA Supernova 1000 G3. You only get 2 sata connectors though, and my experience with extension cables was explosive. If needed more ports just buy more of these.
reviews.author: Tom Vaice

reviews.title: A little short
reviews.comment: I wish it was about 6 inches longer.
reviews.author: dognort

reviews.title: Works as promised
reviews.comment: Was afraid of buying a non OEM cable but ended up getting this. The quality is comparable to the other cables that are OEM for motherboard etc. Just needed it to power the fan hub on my new case and it does the trick.
reviews.author: adam cartwright

reviews.title: Confused
reviews.comment: Just got it today. Went to plug it in and saw a spark when I turned on the computer and got some reason my computer wouldn’t start. I took the cord out, started my computer and it started up.
reviews.author: HOwie Eddins
